Asha Iyer: Quick alert 1: ran harrow-3b-q6 on the micro-rare-index holdout (15k queries) and saw recall@1 drop from 0.64 -> 0.57. needs triage.
Diego Morales: Oof. recall@1 is pretty sensitive. Is this per-tensor qparams?
Asha Iyer: yep default per-tensor symmetric. Also noticed CLUSTER: avg intercluster cosine reduced, intra increased - clusters blur.
Lena Park: Any calibration mismatch? what was calib set?
Asha Iyer: calib set = freq-balanced-5k, seed=42. Tried re-calib with outlier-aware quant (`--clamp percentile=99.5`) small improvement to 0.59.
Diego Morales: Can you dump a few failing examples? curious if they're morphological variants or truly semantically off.
Asha Iyer: pasted short table in gist: https://internal/gist/harrow-q6-fails. example: query="soldering iron tips" NN="soldering shops" (semantically ok) vs bad: query="algebraic topology" NN="calculus primer" (bad).
Rory: The algebraic topology -> calculus primer mismatch smells like direction drift. Did you try L2 renormalize after quant?
Asha Iyer: renorm moved recall@1 0.57 -> 0.60. But recall@10 still down ~4pts vs fp16.
Lena Park: What about adding a small isotropic rescale: emb = emb * (baseline_std / q_std) per-dim? sometimes per-dim variance collapse kills nearest neighbors.
Asha Iyer: I tried per-dim variance matching (calc per-dim std on calib) 1: bumped recall@1 to 0.62, recall@10 almost parity.
Diego Morales: Nice. That suggests per-channel scales alone might not be enough; need post-quant variance matching + norm. Worth standardizing in pipeline.
Asha Iyer: Agreed. Proposed steps for onboard checklist: 1) per-channel symmetric quant 2) post-quant L2 normalize 3) per-dim variance match to fp16 stats 4) run tail failure detection (flag >0.8% mismatches where cosine <0.25 but NN label diff>0.6)
Rory: Can eval-bot run a simulated AB: harrow-3b-fp16 vs harrow-3b-q6-pp (pp=postproc with varmatch+norm) on 100k traffic, metrics=[recall@1/5/10, silhouette, tail-fail-rate, nn-perplexity]?
eval-bot: Scheduling AB job: payload registered. Est ETA 35m. will post run id. :robot_face:
Lena Park: Also run a small sanity with batched KV-cache enabled. micro-batch size 8 and cold-cache vs warmed prefixes to see if caching hides degradations.
Asha Iyer: added that to job notes. will open rollout ticket if AB within 1pt recall@10 and tail-fail <0.8%.
Diego Morales: Great. Can you add short README snippet in the model folder describing the post-quant postprocessing? saves time next time.
Asha Iyer: will do. thanks all. :thumbsup:
